name: Tokyo Academy
source:
Tokyo Academy is about an 20year old freshman enrolling in Tokyo Academy.
You'll be playing his life, make decisions for him and see the outcome that your choices have.
You will meet tons of beautiful girls and older women, be it in class, at home, or somewhere in the city.
Your actions decide what path you take with them and who you end up with.​

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/tokyo-academy-v0-1-waldovn.129166/]F95zone[/url]]
translation:
东京学园讲述了一名20岁的新生就读于东京学园的故事。
你将扮演他的生活，为他做出决定，并看到你的选择所带来的结果。
无论是在课堂上、在家里还是在城市的某个地方，你都会遇到很多漂亮的女孩和年长的女性。
你的行动决定了你与他们一起走的路以及你最终会和谁在一起。​

[来自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/tokyo-academy-v0-1-waldovn.129166/]F95zone[/url]]
